content.text:
The message view is ready. Each turn has its own labeled box.

Tool activity and internal context are hidden.
Your inputs and my replies stay in order.
You can review the conversation while writing your next reply.
Expand the messages whenever you need the full detail.
The draft stays in place while you switch views.
